candidate.display_name: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
candidate.identity_status: The exact sealed long_horizon source section is source-qualified by artifact blob and paper title but supplies no machine candidate id. This audit must not be fuzzy/canonical-joined until a bootstrap-valid schema-2 producer supplies an exact source_local_candidate_id mapping.

published_claims.primary_scope: AgentRewind records aligned agent-context and controlled-environment checkpoints, lets the agent choose a prior checkpoint, restores context/workspace, injects cumulative rewind memory, and resumes on a new suffix. The paper reports improved success/checklist progress across models, strategies, benchmarks and harnesses.
published_claims.reported_value_status: Primary-study values extracted from the paper via current detailed paper summaries/reviews; arithmetic differences are reconstructable, but no raw paper run bundle was located and these values were not independently rerun in this audit.

support: README exposes record/replay/fork/backtrack, Git workspace restoration and experimental sandbox checkpoint/navigation.
replay/backtrack.py defines default candidate limit 80 and default agent-direct target selection.
official tests exercise last-80 LLM candidate rendering, target validation, fork materialization and Git-workspace rollback semantics.
public provenance identifies internal source implementation snapshot fe5558f678546c60aef6dc58b6a9bdf8914f644c and public alpha release boundary.
important_limits: Public v2 is explicitly a cleaned release tree rather than imported private experiment history.
Provenance explicitly excludes real traces/run outputs, private benchmark adapters/evaluators/verifiers, score/report pipelines and model-routing guards.
README labels sandbox alpha; process memory and external effects are not guaranteed to rewind.
Python dependency constraints are lower bounds (for example openai>=1.0, pydantic>=2) rather than an exact lock for the paper runtime.

support: Public repository contains 82 task specifications, 640 ordered criteria, deterministic per-task verifier code and a manifest.
Workspace tarballs are publicly downloadable from KelvinCoffee/MettleBench on Hugging Face.
Reference forward/order-violating runs exist but are gated separately.
important_limits: download_data.py calls snapshot_download without a revision parameter, so an exact reproduction should pin the Hugging Face dataset revision explicitly rather than rely on moving repository state.
The public benchmark repository does not contain the paper's raw model trajectories or aggregate result bundle.

selection_quality_scope_correction.supported: The paper's paired recovery experiment is strong evidence that the full rewind-equipped recovery bundle can outperform continuing from identical failed endpoints under the tested setup. Public runtime code also concretely implements agent-visible candidate selection over up to 80 prior LLM decision records.
selection_quality_scope_correction.not_supported: The evidence does not isolate checkpoint-target selection quality from rewind availability, memory, and extra recovery opportunity. No matched random-target, latest-safe-target, oracle-target or causal-target ablation was located in the primary reported design.
selection_quality_scope_correction.consequence: Do not use AgentRewind's aggregate or paired gains as evidence that its agent-direct checkpoint selector is close to optimal, or as direct validation of a learned/causal target selector. The source worker's selector-only factorial remains a genuinely open experiment.

public_code_scope_guard.probabilistic_suffix: Current public alpha also contains a probabilistic-suffix target-selection policy and tests, but this is not treated here as evidence for the paper's reported agent-direct target-selection quality unless a paper-linked configuration explicitly binds to it.
public_code_scope_guard.rollback_boundary: File/workspace restoration is well supported inside the controlled boundary. Process memory, network requests, external-service calls and other outside effects are not generally undoable; this does not negate the controlled MettleBench result but limits deployment generalization.

independent_replication_search.result: No protocol-matched independent numerical rerun of the 82-task MettleBench AgentRewind comparison or the paired failed-endpoint recovery experiment was located. Unrelated projects that independently use the AgentRewind name were not counted as replications.
independent_replication_search.classification: not located, not evidence of non-replicability

reproducibility_assessment.mechanism: Strongly artifact-supported at the public-runtime level: checkpoint/fork/backtrack, 80-candidate interface, memory discipline and workspace restoration are concretely implemented and tested.
reproducibility_assessment.benchmark: Strong static benchmark support, with public task/evaluator definitions. Exact dataset provenance should additionally pin the Hugging Face snapshot; gated reference runs are useful validation evidence but are not necessary to execute scoring after access to workspaces.
reproducibility_assessment.headline_results: Still primary-study evidence. The public release boundary intentionally excludes the private experiment/score infrastructure and real run outputs, so reproducing paper numbers requires reconstructing paper-specific harness/adapters/configuration around the public core plus provider access.
reproducibility_assessment.target_selector: Untested as an isolated causal component. Recovery availability is supported; selection quality is not separately established.

reopen_conditions: author-affiliated release of the exact paper experiment harness/config/model-routing layer or raw trajectories/result bundle
immutable paper-linked Hugging Face workspace/reference snapshot identifiers plus exact runtime dependency/model snapshot pins
protocol-matched independent numerical rerun of MettleBench or the paired failed-endpoint experiment
matched target-selection ablation such as random/latest-safe/oracle/causal target under identical rewind availability, memory and post-rewind budget
material change in public runtime that is explicitly linked to the paper configuration
exact_next_action: Do not re-audit unchanged AgentRewind. On the next bootstrap-valid invocation, freeze the then-current exact ACTIVE_WAVE and rotate to a different source-qualified non-evaluation candidate, preferably a genuinely new open_source or cross_field candidate with executable official artifacts. Revisit AgentRewind only on a listed reopen condition.
